name: vstar-bench-bbox
description: A dataset for evaluating object localization and bounding-box prediction performance in visual reasoning tasks. It provides images with annotated bounding boxes and measures how accurately models can predict object locations relevant to specified queries or visual tasks. The benchmark is suitable for testing object detection/localization components of multimodal systems.
reputation: A community-contributed dataset with limited but growing use for bounding-box/localization evaluation in visual reasoning experiments.
